name: Wellington
housing: Wellington renters live in older wooden houses on steep hills, flats and inner-city apartments.

localRules.text: Landlords in New Zealand must give a receipt for the bond and lodge it with Tenancy Services within 23 working days of receiving it.

tenantHelp.name: Tenancy Services
tenantHelp.what: government tenancy service: bonds, rights and the Tenancy Tribunal

climate: Wellington is windy and wet, so check for draughts, leaks and mould and test the heating.
fact: Many Wellington homes are on steep hillsides reached by steps or a cable car, so check access at move-in.
